messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: You should not use methylphenidate if you are allergic to it, or if you have:
- glaucoma:
- pheochromocytoma (tumor of the adrenal gland);
- severe high blood pressure or a heart problem;
- overactive thyroid;
- a personal or family history of tics (muscle twitches) or Tourette's syndrome; or
- severe anxiety, tension, or agitation (stimulant medicine can make these symptoms worse).
Stimulants have caused stroke, heart attack, and sudden death in certain people. Tell your doctor if you have:
- heart problems or a congenital heart defect;
- high blood pressure; or
- a family history of heart disease or sudden death.
Do not use methylphenidate if you have used an MAO inhibitor in the past 14 days. A dangerous drug interaction could occur. MAO inhibitors include isocarboxazid, linezolid, methylene blue injection, phenelzine, and tranylcypromine.
Triplet: ["mao inhibitor", "includes", "linezolid"]

The relation 'includes' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug class or category includes the specific drug or substance specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
B. 'are commonly prescribed': The subject drug class is frequently prescribed among the categories specified by the object entity.
C. 'has controlled substance schedule': The subject drug is classified under the controlled substance schedule specified by the object entity.
D. 'distinguished from': The subject drug can be differentiated or identified as separate from the substance specified by the object entity.
E. 'has legal instruction': The subject drug has a legal instruction or regulation associated with it as specified by the object entity.
